$Comment: A Pumpkin Fiend Hatchling on the Headless Horseman's hard ride, raised by the hard ride's FightWaves in place of the normal Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling. Like that one it is a Variant of the wild Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend (whose comment says how it is built), so its look, nameplate, drop list and 6 damage hit are that file's, and Modify names only the two Parameters the wild fiend declares for its kin: more health, MaxHealth 130 against the normal Hatchling's 60, the same step up as the Horseman's own hard health (2376 against 1100), and FlockArray naming this role's own id. It has an id of its own so that only the fight's fiends are in Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Adds_Group, which his fight waits on and clears when it resets. It never spawns in the wild. A kill pays Hallowed favor (it is in Hallows_Eve_Event_Mobs) and counts for Old Jack's fiend jobs.
